injected_bug: Send button is type=button, so the form never submits
root_cause: The Send button in contact.html is declared with type="button", so clicking it never submits the form. The POST to /contact never happens, the page stays on /contact, and the 'Thank you' text never appears.

injected_bug: Homepage 'Contact us' link points to a route that does not exist
root_cause: The homepage 'Contact us' link (#contact-link) points to /contact-us, but the Flask app only defines a GET route at /contact, so the click lands on a 404 'Not Found' page.

injected_bug: Contact form posts to a route that does not exist
root_cause: The contact form posts to /send-message, but the Flask app only defines POST /contact. The request returns 404 'Not Found', so the thank-you page never renders.
